pair_support: (verified P1.4 SIFT and HSV<=0.5) OR (HSV<=0.12 and gray MAD<=0.035); failed SIFT is absence of support, never proof of difference
grouping: deterministic degree-first greedy complete-link cover on quality-eligible frames; all pairs in each group must support; no transitive connected-component merging
prototype_selection: medoid under HSV distance, then farthest-first HSV coverage; quality breaks ties; stop at three or max uncovered distance<=0.02
acceptance: size/span gate AND at least one supported non-prototype holdout; provisional visual context only
assignment: exclude self pairs; require supported prototype pair; best HSV with relative runner-up gap>=0.2; competing groups with verified SIFT both count as strong -> ambiguous; no forced winner
midpoints: chronological confirmed occurrences; last supported left/first supported right midpoint is an organizing boundary, bracket retained; no two-sided support -> unknown
refinement: one pass: expand midpoint into supported bracket, preserve unknown cells; withdraw boundary with continuous photometric explanation across every bracket link; overlapping brackets stay ambiguous; no recursive splitting
stop: one grouping, one prototype pass, one boundary revision; max240 frames/30000 pairs; budget exceeded -> uniform/V fallback with complete unknown coverage; local resample max160 candidates, no tuning
selection: same candidate pool and budget8; v05 reserves per-refined-interval coverage (longest intervals first if >budget), fills by frozen V order; quality<8 excluded, if all fail deliver none and preserve unknown range; original V and uniform controls retained
resample: one scripted tool-loop request from first automatic boundary bracket or middle third; 10fps; re-decode original source, never filter coarse cache; no Agent understanding experiment
evaluation: references loaded only after all predictions; known development/regression materials; no physical identity accuracy or generalization claim; no parameter sweeps or training
